cases.title: Scenario sensitivity · BRL
cases.note: All inputs are scenario assumptions, not measured Nubank effects. Capacity equivalent is not cash saved. The realization slider reduces benefit only; all costs remain at their scenario values. This is sensitivity analysis, not a probability or a causal estimate.
cases.formula: period_net = benefit × realization − variable_cost − run_cost; first_year = 12 × period_net − build_cost

cases.title: Scenario sensitivity · BRL
cases.note: All inputs are scenario assumptions, not measured Nubank effects. Capacity equivalent is not cash saved.
